Examples.Title: Retrieve activity data for a given user ID
Examples.Description: Fetches completed workout sessions, with a defined start and end time and activity type (e.g. running, cycling, etc.)
Examples.Code:
### Retrieve activity data for a given user ID
# @name Activity_Fetch
GET {{host}}/activity?user_id={{user_id}}&start_date={{start_date}}&end_date={{end_date}}&to_webhook={{to_webhook}}&with_samples={{with_samples}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json, application/problem+json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Returned upon successful data request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: One or more parameters is malformed. The `detail` field describes the specific problem.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json
# 401
# Description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json
# 404
# Description: A referenced resource does not exist on Terra's end.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json

Examples.Title: Resend a previously delivered webhook payload
Examples.Description:
Re-dispatches a stored normalised payload to your configured webhook
destinations, identified by the original webhook event ID. The user
and data type are read from the stored payload itself, so only the
event ID is required.
Examples.Code:
### Resend a previously delivered webhook payload
# @name Webhooks_ResendPayload
POST {{host}}/payload/resend
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, application/problem+json

{
  "event_id": "5b04b6a4-09bd-4fc4-8bbb-6c44f0a2c0ef"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Returned when the payload was successfully re-queued for delivery.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: One or more parameters is malformed. The `detail` field describes the specific problem.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json

Examples.Title: Create a workout template
Examples.Description: Stores a reusable workout template. Plan it onto a user's calendar with `POST /workouts/{workout_id}/plan` — the template itself carries no date and is not pushed to any provider until planned.
Examples.Code:
### Create a workout template
# @name Workouts_CreateWorkout
POST {{host}}/workouts
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, application/problem+json

{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "sport": "running",
  "environment": "indoor",
  "pool_length_meters": 0,
  "step_blocks": [
    {
      "completion_condition": {},
      "steps": []
    }
  ],
  "estimated_duration_seconds": 0,
  "estimated_distance_meters": 0,
  "estimated_calories": 0,
  "workout_id": "string"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Template stored
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: One or more parameters is malformed. The `detail` field describes the specific problem.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json
# 401
# Description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json

Examples.Title: Delete a workout template
Examples.Description: Deletes the template and cascades deletion of every planned workout created from it, including removal from connected providers.
Examples.Code:
### Delete a workout template
# @name Workouts_DeleteWorkout
DELETE {{host}}/workouts/{{workout_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json, application/problem+json

## Responses
# 204
# Description: Template and all planned instances deleted
# 207
# Description: Some provider-side deletions failed; the template is retained. Retry to complete the cascade.

# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json
# 404
# Description: A referenced resource does not exist on Terra's end.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json
# 424
# Description: Provider-side deletion could not be performed; retry later.
# Content-Type: application/problem+json

Examples.Title: Plan a workout onto a user's calendar
Examples.Description: Schedules the workout template for a user on a given date and pushes it to the user's connected provider (or queues it for SDK delivery). Athlete metrics personalise zone-based targets for this plan only.
Examples.Code:
### Plan a workout onto a user's calendar
# @name Workouts_PlanWorkout
POST {{host}}/workouts/{{workout_id}}/plan?user_id={{user_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, application/problem+json

{
  "planned_date": "2025-01-01",
  "ftp": 0,
  "max_heart_rate": 0,
  "threshold_heart_rate": 0,
  "threshold_speed": 0,
  "pool_length_meters": 0
}
